message: Scaled 2 of 5 feed rates to 150 %; 1 left by the value filter, 2 left because the value filter cannot be compared with them, 1 clamped to a limit. No machine: profile defaults assumed.

findings.message: F0.20 would become 0.30; the largest feed (0.25) was used instead.
F0.35 is at or above the "only feeds below" value (0.3), so it is left as it is.
F200. is not scaled: it is a feed per minute, and the "only feeds below" value (0.3) is for feeds per revolution, so whether it passes the filter cannot be told. It is left as it is.
F80. is not scaled: it is a feed per minute, and the "only feeds below" value (0.3) is for feeds per revolution, so whether it passes the filter cannot be told. It is left as it is.
